TODO: delete the comment before merging.
Possible panic point. Can this happen when named fields does not have an identifier? Afaik, all fields in a struct has a name e.g. `symbol: &str`.

Do I understand it correctly that it will fail to load the config if any of the required properties are missing?

I really love the idea of automatic config loader derivation but I'm worried that it doesnt cover default values. So either users will have to set all properties even though they might only want to customize one or every property is marked optional with unwrap_or across the module implementations
No, `load_config` will merge user's config with `Self`, which is probably the default config, while `from_config` will fail if any of the items is missing.
Uhh. I didn't see that. That's amazing!
Good call using the depreciated attribute! 👍
